title: Characteristic function of a Gaussian vector
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $X$ be the random vector in $\mathbb R^n$ whose coordinates are independent standard Gaussian random variables. For every $t\in\mathbb R^n$, the characteristic function of $X$ at $t$ is $\exp(-\|t\|^2/2)$.
